items.q: We finally recorded for Liscio Records one [CD] with my quintet, which was Lida and I on the front line, J. B. Dyas and . . .

ctx.x: That was a very, very good group. I've tried to keep some version of a group together. We finally recorded for Liscio Records one [CD] with my quintet, which was Lida and I on the front line, J. B. Dyas and . . .
